description:
FILED s532 (Fable 5.1, 2026-11-02) from the round board run on MAIN-READY-63 (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s532/review/board-main63.rows.tsv vs baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv: `tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl --diff` printed 18 FIXED).  Twelve of them -- IO-Compress-2.214-0 105oneshot-{gzip,zip,deflate}.t rows 3 5 6 7 (NS:ns-error-location + #330) -- were NOT fixed: in the board run each file produced ONE row and died (*PLAN* "ran 1 of 1008, rc 1"; the blessed *PLAN* says "ran 8 of 1008, rc 2"), so rows 3-7 were never reached; alone on the same tree (`tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows ~/.cpan/build/IO-Compress-2.214-0 t/105oneshot-gzip.t`, scratch review/rerun/bisect-oneshot.log) the file runs 8 rows and rows 3 5 6 7 still fail exactly as blessed.  Four more (Template-Toolkit compile5.t rows 8 10 12 14) were "FIXED" the same way: the file died after 3 rows in the whole-board run (#4381's order race).  So 16 of the run's 18 FIXED were artifacts; only Role-Tiny load-module.t 5 (#1688) and HTTP-Message zipbomb's *FILE* row were real.  THE INSTRUMENT GAP: tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl --diff (lines ~157-215) computes FIXED = blessed-failing rows absent from the current failing rows; it does not know how many rows the file PRODUCED.  tools/sweep-diff.pl solves this with the `?` UNVERIFIED bucket (a blessed row above the file's abort point is unverified, never fixed) and the sweep prints `N blessed row(s) unverified` per file.  FIX SHAPE (tools, task #1502's instrument): --diff reads the current per-file table (the --tsv output, or the *PLAN* row's "ran N of M") and reports a blessed row with number > N as UNVERIFIED (`?`), never FIXED; a *PLAN* row whose got-text moved (ran 8 -> ran 1) is a MISMATCH line.  Also worth recording: the early abort itself (1 of 1008 under the loaded 4-job board, 8 alone) is the shape of the #1338 shared-module-cache race -- re-run alone and cite, as the sweep rule says.  Layer: tools.  Queued: s532b (tools member, with #4381).

=== DONE (s532b) ===
FIXED (tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl --diff): split_fixed -- a blessed failing row the current run did not produce is UNVERIFIED (`?`), never FIXED, when its file STOPPED short (the current *FILE* row: ran 0; the current *PLAN* row's "ran M of N, rc R": rows numbered above M) or, with --board-current, when the file is not in the current per-file table; a *PLAN* row in both files whose shortfall text moved prints `MISMATCH *PLAN* DIST FILE: blessed '...', now '...'`; the summary is `N NEW / N FIXED / N UNVERIFIED / N LOST`.  REPLAYED on the s532 round (board-main63 vs the baseline at b31345ca): 11 NEW / 2 FIXED (zipbomb *FILE*, Role-Tiny load-module.t 5 -- the two real ones) / 16 UNVERIFIED (the 12 IO-Compress 105oneshot rows, the 4 TT compile5.t rows) + five MISMATCH *PLAN* lines.  tools/t/cpan-scoreboard.t +4 rows.
subject: The CPAN board's --diff has no UNVERIFIED bucket: a blessed failing row in a file that aborted BEFORE reaching it is reported FIXED (s532 round: 12 IO-Compress 105oneshot rows "FIXED" while the files ran 1 of 1008 rows; alone they run 8 and the rows still fail) -- the sweep's diff has the `?` bucket, the board's must too
